inputs.text: A continuous four-second hand-drawn cartoon shot. The small exhausted dungeon repair worker on the left wears a teal hood, round brass goggles and a brown leather work apron. In the first two seconds he trudges slowly toward screen right with two short heavy shuffling steps. His boots alternately lift and plant on the stone floor; his body moves forward and bobs slightly. He drags the small rectangular wheeled toolbox behind him with one hand and holds a wrench in the other. Then he stops walking. His shoulders rise as he inhales, his eyes close, his chin drops, and his shoulders sink as he opens his mouth and lets out a long tired sigh. A small white breath puff drifts from his mouth and dissipates. Comically weary body language. The smiling skeleton skull on the crate at the right stays in place. Locked camera, full body stays in frame, continuous natural movement. Consistent thick ink outlines, warm comic shading, same face, outfit, toolbox and dungeon background.
